cards.title: Tidepool Lab Shell Greeting
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for writing a friendly greeting between two made-up tidepool helpers inside a blanket fort story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold two paper shell badges, and choose a pretend tidepool task for the speakers: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write two short greeting lines that fit a quiet lab scene and help the story begin: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the shell sorter. The first greeting line is: ____________________.
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the tide clock keeper. The answer greeting is: ____________________.
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that names who spoke, such as the shell sorter said: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show the speaker feels careful by adding one small action: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write the next reply so the tidepool task can start: ____________________.
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Revise one greeting so it sounds more like a helpful lab worker: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to the shell badge first, then write only one greeting line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use two paper shells to make a new greeting scene: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Reply
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for writing a question and reply between fictional ferry crew members revising a draft sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw two ferry docks on scrap paper, and choose one foggy pretend sentence: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a question that asks what should change, then write a reply with a clear choice: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the dock guide. The question about the foggy sentence is: ____________________.
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the ferry captain. The clear reply is: ____________________.
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that fits the river setting, such as the captain called from the rail: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show the dock guide feels unsure with one action or detail: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write a second reply that explains which word should be changed: ____________________.
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Revise the ferry captain's reply so it sounds confident but polite: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write the question first, then underline the reply that solves it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Draw two docks and write one question-reply pair for a made-up sentence: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Museum Object Line

cards.adultSetup: Print the card, stack three blank paper labels, and invent one museum object for the top label: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write dialogue where one speaker notices the object and the other speaker responds with a clue: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the label keeper. The object-noticing line is: ____________________.
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the tower guide. The clue reply is: ____________________.
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that shows the label keeper points to the paper label: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show curiosity with a small movement, face clue, or pause: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write the next reply that connects the object to the next label: ____________________.
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Revise one line so the clue feels sharper and less plain: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the object on a label, then write one clue line under it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Make a paper museum label and give it one spoken clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Polite Disagreement
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for practicing polite disagreement between two fictional compass makers choosing a craft direction: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a small compass dial, and choose two possible directions for the academy project: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write two lines where the speakers disagree, but both stay respectful and focused on the craft problem: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the compass apprentice. The first opinion line is: ____________________.
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the pattern coach. The polite disagreement line is: ____________________.
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that shows calm speech, such as the coach answered evenly: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show the apprentice feels determined with one action: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write a reply that offers a compromise for the compass design: ____________________.
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Revise the disagreement so it is clearer and kinder: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the polite disagreement line beside the compass arrow: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Fold a paper compass and write one respectful disagreement about its direction: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Closing Line
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for ending a fictional boardwalk booklet scene with a strong closing line: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold three scrap pages into a tiny booklet, and choose the final boardwalk problem: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write two ending lines that show the booklet problem is settled and the scene can close: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the page binder. The near-ending line is: ____________________.
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the ribbon keeper. The closing answer is: ____________________.
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that shows the speaker touches the finished booklet: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show relief or pride with one quiet action: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write one final reply that does not start a new problem: ____________________.
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Revise the closing line so it feels complete and specific: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Box the line that closes the scene, then copy it here: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Make a tiny paper booklet and write one closing line for its last page: ____________________.
